title: Average of a fixed-coordinate projection
statement: Let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and let $g$ be a real-valued function of sign assignments on the complement of $J$. If $x$ is uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$, then the average of $g$ applied to the restriction of $x$ to that complement equals the uniform average of $g$ over all sign assignments on the complement.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
$g$ is real-valued on sign assignments indexed by the complement of $J$
